Derivation: gap facts are source-grounded in the concept note's literature review; the novelty claim that the specific three-component combination is absent from the 50-study literature is derived from the gap matrix evidence combined with the precedent treatment (Bayesian Maximum Entropy, copula-based, dynamic Bayesian networks, MF-FusionNet, each documented in concept_note.md as lacking the full three-component integration).
